title: AIMS Mode B — Stakeholder Briefing
$comment: CORRECTED. The prior revision of this file was the pre-expansion Phase-0 standard: it declared 15 required assets under field names largely disjoint from what the Storyteller Agent actually emits, and it modelled the 18 assets as direct children of `content` rather than as members of `content.assets`. Neither shipped example validated against it. The asset list below is transcribed from AIMS_MODE_B_REQUIRED_ASSETS in agents/storyteller/storyteller.py, and the object shape from the artifacts in artifacts/examples/. Where a nested field was documented in the agent's output contract but not directly observed in a shipped example, it is defined as an optional property rather than required — this schema is deliberately permissive about asset internals and strict about asset presence, which is what the L1 omission audit actually enforces. See docs/engineering_process.md, entry E-6.
description: Human sign-off required. 18 required assets. Emitted by the Storyteller Agent when system output routes to Mode B rather than Mode A — novel analytical findings, first-principles inventions, a Brittle Red-Team verdict, an A/B ship/no-ship recommendation, a new data product, an architectural change, or an L3+ escalation. Mode B output is never auto-approved.

provenance.description: Upstream artifact IDs. A Mode B briefing is derived from at least a Capability Bundle and an Evidence Bundle.

status.description: BLOCKED means one or more deterministic L1 checks failed. A blocked briefing is still written to the artifact store, with its violations attached, so the Diagnostic Agent can observe the failure. It is not deleted and it is not shipped.

assets.description: The 18 required Mode B assets. Presence of all 18 is enforced at runtime by the L1 omission audit; absence blocks the briefing.

executive_narrative.description: 1. Plain-language stakeholder brief. Non-technical, no statistical notation, no UUIDs. Must pass the non-technical comprehensibility test or the output is returned rather than shipped.

discovery_path.description: 3. Every step from question to finding, replayable.

financial_projection.description: 4. Cost of inaction versus cost of countermeasure deployment.

methodology.description: Plain language. No UUIDs. Citation markers in [^N] form.

recommended_action.description: 5. Plain-language decision first; technical parameters confined to the annex.

primary.description: The business decision, in plain language. Algorithm names, thresholds and parameters do not belong here.

known_limitations.description: 7. Concrete observations that would invalidate the finding.

statistical_verdict.description: 8. Statistician verdict and test summaries. Technical layer — statistical notation is permitted here.

visualizations_spec.description: 9. Chart specifications. The Storyteller renders these to PNG; specifying without rendering is a system failure.

title.description: Narrative conclusion, not a description, per the visual design system.

insights.description: Canonical field name for the visualization narrative.

scale_impact_declaration.description: 10. Per-axis improvement claim. No composite multiplier.

revision_log.description: 11. Readiness-checklist iteration log. Initialised empty; the system appends entries.

generation_mode_declaration.description: 12. Which reasoning modes were used — analogical, first-principles, extended.

lineage_trace.description: 13. Agents invoked, data sources, content hashes, compute consumed. UUIDs are permitted here and only here.

role_responsibility_mapping.description: 14. Which analytics-engineering responsibility this output fulfils.

addressed_constraints.description: 15. Which Constraint Register entries this output resolves.

footnotes.description: 16. Numbered citations referenced by [^N] markers in the narrative. The L1 citation-coverage check resolves every factual claim against this index.

external_dependencies.description: 17. External decision gates: security, legal, budget, regulatory.

human_approval_gate.description: 18. Explicit operator decision required. No auto-approve.

assets_present.description: Names of the assets actually assembled. A briefing may be BLOCKED with all 18 present — asset completeness and L1 compliance are independent conditions.

l1_compliance_summary.description: Result of the deterministic checks. These are not advisory. overall_passed false blocks the briefing, and the LLM orchestrator cannot override it.

causal_check.description: Veto 1 — no causal assertion without causal evidence in the upstream analysis.

citation_check.description: Veto 2 — factual claims must resolve to the citation index.

omission_check.description: Veto 3 — every finding flagged material upstream must appear in the output.

lineage.description: Upstream artifacts this briefing was derived from.

no_auto_approve.description: Permanently locked. No auto-approve under any condition — not on timeout, not on operator absence. Silence is not approval.
